ray_cast.semantics: Every pixel whose colour c has src[c] > 0 (colour 0 is background and never a source) shoots a ray in each direction d with dirs[d] > 0, directions in order: up, up-right, right, down-right, down, down-left, left, up-left. stop = argmax(stop): 0 the ray paints every cell to the edge except source pixels; 1 the ray stops before the first non-background cell; 2 the ray skips over non-background cells and paints only background cells. Paint colour: if max(paint) > 0 then argmax(paint), otherwise the source pixel's own colour.

tile_orient.semantics: pr = argmax(per)+1 tile rows, pc = argmax(pec)+1 tile columns (each at most 4). Tile (i,j) of the output is the input grid transformed by k = argmax(orient[i][j]) (8 numbers): 0 identity, 1 fliplr, 2 flipud, 3 rot180, 4 transpose, 5 rot90 clockwise, 6 rot90 counter-clockwise, 7 anti-transpose. Only i<pr, j<pc are used. Transposing transforms need a square input.
